# Aashish Pandey

> Project Manager and Creative Technologist in Bangalore, India. Project Manager at Langoor (an LS Digital company). 7+ years and 50+ websites and platforms shipped since 2018 for Unilever, Reliance, Marriott and others. Open to Program Manager roles and taking freelance briefs.

- [Full-stack developer](https://aashishpandey.com/full-stack-developer): Full-stack developer in Bangalore: custom CMS and eCommerce, WordPress, Shopify and Webflow builds, and CI/CD with Docker and GitHub Actions. Open to freelance briefs.
- [SEO consultant](https://aashishpandey.com/seo-consultant): SEO consultant in Bangalore: technical SEO, hreflang for multi-market sites, GEO for AI search and Search Console reporting, from StoryNest to Liquid I.V.
- [UI and UX design](https://aashishpandey.com/ui-ux-design): UI and UX design that ships inside a launch, from a 20-day Talenti Canada site to NSKT Global. Project manager and developer who designs when a project needs it.
- [Tech consultant](https://aashishpandey.com/tech-consultant): Technology consultant in Bangalore: solution architecture, vendor handovers with zero downtime, managed-support models and digital transformation consulting.
- [Free tools](https://aashishpandey.com/tools): small tools that run in the browser, listed roughly by how often people search for them: a QR code generator (static codes that never expire), an invoice generator with six templates, tax set-ups by country and a signature, a password generator, an image resizer and converter, a URL shortener with QR codes, a lorem ipsum generator, an online notepad, a time zone meeting planner, a file hash checker, a photo metadata (EXIF) remover, a project estimate calculator, a QR code checker that shows whether a code is dynamic, and website launch checklists.
